Ready to make your next big professional move? Join us on our journey to achieve our big dream of building the most loved restaurant brands in the world.

Restaurant Brands International Inc. is one of the world's largest quick service restaurant companies with nearly $45 billion in annual system-wide sales and over 32,000 restaurants in more than 120 countries and territories.

RBI owns four of the world's most prominent and iconic quick service restaurant brands – TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES®, and FIREHOUSE SUBS®. These independently operated brands have been serving their respective guests, franchisees and communities for decades. Through its Restaurant Brands for Good framework, RBI is improving sustainable outcomes related to its food, the planet, and people and communities.

RBI is committed to growing the TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES® and FIREHOUSE SUBS® brands by leveraging their respective core values, employee and franchisee relationships, and long track records of community support. Each brand benefits from the global scale and shared best practices that come from ownership by Restaurant Brands International Inc.

The Sr. Analyst of Compensation will support the design and execution of RBI’s global compensation program that impacts how our corporate and restaurant-level employees are rewarded. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role at the intersection of HR, Finance, and Strategy, and it is an exceptional development opportunity for candidates who know RBI's business and want to build deep expertise in compensation and total rewards.

Our Compensation Team is a global function responsible for RBI’s:

• Compensation Framework and Execution: Market pricing, benchmarking, and market intelligence analysis using multiple survey sources to support pay range, grade, job leveling, and offer recommendations.
• Restaurant Incentive Program Support: Partner with the business to motivate and reward employees and drive the right outcomes across our 1,000+ company restaurants.

This role – Sr. Analyst, Compensation – reports to the Sr. Manager, Compensation and is responsible for collaborating with leaders to execute on critical compensation programs for all RBI brands and regions. With exposure to our business units and functions, this role provides an excellent opportunity to grow as our function evolves.

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in the setup, execution, and management of compensation programs, experience in working with leaders and business stakeholders, and proven ability to build and improve processes.

Responsibilities

Compensation Program Design & Analysis

• Lead complex market pricing, benchmarking, and market intelligence analysis using multiple survey sources to support pay range, grade, job leveling, and offer recommendations.
• Analyze base pay, variable pay, incentive eligibility, range positioning, compression, and internal equity to identify risks and recommend data-driven remediation actions.

• Build, maintain, and improve compensation models, reporting, and recurring analytics to monitor market competitiveness, program effectiveness, and workforce trends.

Governance & Program Execution

• Support pay transparency and compensation compliance activities, including posted pay range guidance, pay range documentation, audit support, and partnership with Legal and HR.
• Support annual merit and compensation planning processes from budget modeling through employee-level delivery and communications.
• Partner with Talent Acquisition, HR Business Partners, Finance, and business leaders on total compensation offers, promotional increases, retention requests, and exception reviews.
• Utilize HR technology, analytics tools, automation, and responsible AI-enabled solutions to streamline day-to-day compensation proces

AudioCodes (Nasdaq: AUDC) is a global leader in enterprise voice technology and Voice AI innovation for the digital workplace and customer experience. We help organizations unlock the full value of voice, transforming every conversation into a strategic asset that drives smarter decisions, better experiences and business growth. With over 30 years of expertise and presence in more than 100 countries, AudioCodes is trusted by 65 of the Fortune 100 to power intelligent, agile and future-ready interactions across businesses worldwide.

This role owns the Voca CIC training function end-to-end, from strategy and curriculum design through lab development, live delivery, and continuous improvement. You will be the go-to expert for enablement across internal teams, channel partners, and enterprise customers globally, working cross-functionally with Product, R&D, and Sales to keep training aligned with the product and the market. If you want to be the person who makes sure every partner, customer, and teammate truly understands how to unlock the power of Voca CIC. This is where it happens.

Voca CIC is AudioCodes’ flagship, award-winning Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) portfolio, designed to meet organizations where they are today and where they’re going next. The portfolio covers two distinct opportunities: a Microsoft Teams-native contact center for organizations standardized on the Microsoft ecosystem, and a voice-platform-agnostic AI Receptionist that runs on top of any phone system.

Voca CIC for Microsoft Teams is an AI-first, full omnichannel contact center, Microsoft Teams Unify certified and built natively in Azure on the same voice backbone that powers Microsoft Teams Phone. That delivers the tightest integration model on the market. Where other vendors “plug into” Teams through loose connectors, Voca CIC lives inside Teams, so every Teams user can play a role in the service workflow.

It is AI-first by design, embedding Conversational AI and Generative AI into the agent and customer journey through AI voice agents, AI call summarization, and sentiment analysis, alongside an omnichannel toolkit that unifies voice, chat, and email into a single agent screen. Voca CIC has won three major industry awards in two years (CX Today Best Microsoft Teams Contact Center 2024, CX Today Best CX Deployment 2025, and UC Today Best Microsoft Teams Contact Center 2025), with more than 200 enterprise customers in production across 12+ Microsoft Azure regions worldwide.

The Voca AI Receptionist is our standalone, entry-level AI offering for businesses of all sizes, from SMB to large enterprise. Built as a multi-platform solution that sits on top of any voice platform (Microsoft Teams, Cisco, Avaya, RingCentral, traditional PBX, or carrier voice services), it dramatically expands our addressable market well beyond the Microsoft footprint. It delivers AI-driven call routing, document and website-grounded Q&A, CRM integration, appointment scheduling, and outbound SMS to organizations looking for a fast on-ramp into AI-powered customer service, regardless of the phone system they already own.

jobs.title: HR Business Partner
jobs.description:
Etsitkö HR-roolia, jossa yksikään päivä ei ole täysin samanlainen? Haluaisitko työn, jossa pääset tapaamaan ihmisiä ympäri Suomen, tekemään tiivistä yhteistyötä liiketoiminnan kanssa ja työskentelemään osana osaavaa HR-tiimiä?

Esperillä HR-työ ei ole pelkkää sähköposteihin vastaamista (vaikka niitäkin päivän aikana kertyy). Ennen kaikkea se on ihmisten kohtaamista, monimutkaisten tilanteiden selkeyttämistä sekä esihenkilöiden tukemista kestävän ja vaikuttavan johtamisen arjessa.

Haemme nyt HR Business Partneria vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Voisiko tämä olla seuraava askel urallasi?

Sujuvien HR-prosessien kautta parempaa arkea
HR Business Partnerina työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä liiketoimintajohtajan, aluepäälliköiden ja yksiköidemme esihenkilöiden kanssa. Vastuualueellesi kuuluu noin 80 Esperi-kotia ja noin 2 000 työntekijää.

Tehtäväsi on varmistaa, että arjen henkilöstöprosessit toimivat sujuvasti ja lainmukaisesti. Tämä tarkoittaa esimerkiksi rekrytointien, perehdytysten, työkykyasioiden, työsuhdekäytäntöjen ja osaamisen kehittämisen tukemista sekä sitä, että toimintatavat noudattavat konsernin ohjeita, työehtosopimuksia ja työlainsäädäntöä.

Kuulostaako hieman byrokraattiselta? Käytännössä työ on kuitenkin ennen kaikkea ihmisten kanssa työskentelyä. Päiväsi täyttyvät keskusteluista, kysymyksistä, ratkaisujen etsimisestä ja päätöksenteon tukemisesta. Esihenkilöiden ei tarvitse osata ulkoa kaikkia työlainsäädännön pykäliä – siihen tehtävään olet sinä. Samalla osaat hyödyntää koko HR-tiimin osaamista ja ohjata asiat oikeille asiantuntijoille silloin, kun siihen on tarvetta.

Yksi asia, josta kaikki HR Business Partnerimme ovat yhtä mieltä: työn parhaat hetket syntyvät kodeissamme. Kun pääsee tapaamaan esihenkilöitä ja tiimejä kasvotusten, nkee konkreettisesti, miten toimiva henkilöstöarki heijastuu suoraan asukkaidemme saamaan hoivaan.

Vaikuta myös liiketoiminnan kehittämiseen
Arjen HR-tuen lisäksi olet tärkeä osa liiketoiminnan johtamista. Seuraat oman alueesi henkilöstöön liittyviä tunnuslukuja, analysoit niiden kehitystä ja raportoit niistä kuukausittain liiketoiminnan johtoryhmälle.
Tarkastelet alueesi tilannetta kokonaisuutena ja autat löytämään ratkaisuja esimerkiksi työkyvyn, osaamisen kehittämisen, perehdyttämisen ja henkilöstön saatavuuden teemoihin. Tehtävässä raportoit suoraan Esperin HR-johtajalle.

Mitä tästä tehtävästä on hyvä tietää?
Työ sisältää säännöllistä matkustamista Suomessa. Vastuualueesi ulottuu maantieteellisesti etelästä pohjoiseen, joten välillä kilometrejä kertyy. Toisaalta juuri vierailut kodeissamme ovat monen mielestä työn parasta antia.

Kuulut laajaan HR-tiimiin, johon kuuluu lisäksesi kolme muuta HR Business Partneria, kaksi juristia, rekrytointitiimi, HRD-päällikkö, palkkahallinto sekä työvoimahallinnan tiimi. Työskentelemme säännöllisesti yhdessä Helsingin toimistollamme, joten odotamme myös sinulta valmiutta lähityöskentelyyn. Näin tiimi ja toimintatavat tulevat tutuiksi ja yhteistyö on ketterää. Meillä voi luottaa siihen, että apua on aina saatavilla.

Vastuualueesi sijoittuu Esperin ikäihmisten palveluihin. Kotimme tarjoavat pääasiassa ympärivuorokautista asumista ikäihmisille, ja kodeissamme työskentelee suuri joukko sosiaali- ja terveysalan ammattilaisia. Ikäihmisten palveluiden ohella Esperi tarjoaa asumispalveluita mielenterveyskuntoutujille ja vammaispalvelun asiakkaille. Lisäksi konserniimme kuuluvat Saga-Palvelutalot. Kokonaisuudessaan Esperi työllistää yli 7 200 työntekijää ja on yksi Suomen suurimmista työnantajista.

Millaista osaajaa etsimme?
Tarkan muotin sijaan etsimme ennen kaikkea henkilöä, joka viihtyy ihmisten, liiketoiminnan ja käytännön HR-työn rajapinnassa. Toivomme, että sinulla on:

• vahva osaaminen työsuhdeasioista ja työlainsäädännöstä
• vähintään 3–5 vuoden kokemus monipuolisista HR-tehtävistä, esimerkiksi henkilöstöpäällikön tai vastaavan roolista
• halu tehdä tiivistä yhteistyötä ja sparrata kollegoita
• kyky toimia vauhdikkaassa ja jatkuvasti muuttuva

• ליווי אגפים בארגון כ־HR POC וכנקודת הקשר המרכזית בנושאי משאבי אנוש.

*חוויית עובד ותרבות ארגונית*
• הובלת תחום חוויית העובד בארגון.
• בניית תוכנית עבודה שנתית בהתאם לאסטרטגיית אגף משאבי אנוש והוצאתה לפועל.

• ייזום והובלת פעילויות ותהליכים חוצי ארגון בתחומי חוויית העובד.

• הובלת תחום התקשורת הפנים ארגונית.
• בניית אסטרטגיית תקשורת פנים ארגונית ויישומה.

• התוויית מדיניות לפרסומים ארגוניים ברשתות החברתיות.

• ניסיון בתחום חוויית העובד, תקשורת פנים ארגונית או תרבות ארגונית – יתרון.
• ניסיון ביצירת תוכן פנים ארגוני וחיצוני – יתרון.

כישורים אישיים

• יכולת רתימה, השפעה ויצירת שותפויות בארגון.
• חשיבה יצירתית, יוזמה וראייה מערכתית.
• יכולת תקשורת בין־אישית גבוהה.
• יכולת עבודה בסביבה דינמית ומרובת משימות.
• יכולת לעבור מחשיבה אסטרטגית לתכנון ולביצוע בפועל.

**שלב חובה בתהליך הגשת המועמדות – סרטון היכרות**
כחלק מתהליך הסינון הראשוני, יש להשלים סרטון קצר באורך של עד שתי דקות באמצעות הלינק המצורף.
בסרטון נבקש שתספרו על תהליך רוחבי ומשמעותי שהובלתם בשנים האחרונות בארגון שבו עבדתם.
הגשת המועמדות תיחשב מלאה רק לאחר השלמת הסרטון. מועמדות שלא תכלול סרטון לא תוכל להתקדם בתהליך.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our People team are the architects of a great workplace where brilliant minds come together to do their best work. From discovering diverse talent and nurturing future leaders, to creating spaces that spark collaboration and crafting rewards that celebrate success - we're passionate about building a culture where everyone can thrive.

We are seeking a Senior Compensation Design Specialist who is a first principles thinker to join a team focused on running our cycles, designing our site, and building our job architecture and ranges. You will be an integral part of the team that redesigns and maintains DoorDash’s compensation infrastructure as the business scales.

Get to know our People team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the Global Compensation team within Total Rewards. We design and manage programs that motivate and retain top talent globally, providing a consistent and inclusive pay experience for all employees regardless of location.

As Deliveroo, DoorDash, and Wolt continue to integrate, you will play an execution-focused specialist role supporting the delivery of unified compensation frameworks rather than acting as a Compensation Business Partner.

Here’s What Your Day-to-day Might Look Like

Global Framework Integration & Job Architecture

• Harmonise global frameworks: Play a key role in unifying compensation frameworks across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo by supporting the evolution of our global job architecture and salary range structures.
• Maintain architecture & governance: Support the ongoing maintenance and governance of global job architecture, salary ranges, and benchmarking methodologies to ensure consistency as the business scales.

Cycle Execution & Total Rewards

• Deliver compensation review cycles: Partner with the Talent & Rewards Cycle (TRC) team to execute annual and ad hoc compensation cycles, ensuring programs are delivered accurately, efficiently, and with an excellent employee experience.
• Support broad-based rewards: Contribute to the administration and delivery of total pay programs, including base salary and equity / long-term incentive (LTI) structures.

Market Analytics & Operational Excellence

• Conduct market pricing & analysis: Perform market pricing, internal benchmarking, and complex compensation analysis to support informed pay decisions across multiple regions.
• Drive operational precision: Audit compensation data, validate cycle outputs, test new tooling, and identify opportunities to automate and improve compensation processes.
• Partner cross-functionally: Work closely with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Finance, and People Systems to support compensation planning, offer structures, promotions, and organizational changes.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Essential Experience

• Significant broad-based compensation experience: Deep expertise across salary structures, market pricing, global compensation cycles, and job architecture within fast-scaling organisations (executive-only compensation background will not be sufficient).
• Equity & LTI knowledge: Strong understanding of equity and long-term incentive (LTI) programs and how they integrate into broader total rewards strategies.
• Data-driven analytical capability: Demonstrated ability to manage large, complex datasets, perform multi-region compensation analysis, and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
• Operational excellence & process design: Proven track record of executing complex global programs with precision, improving automated tooling, and maintaining strict data governance.
• Global perspective & adaptability: Expertise operating across multi-country compensation frameworks and diverse regional market practices in fast-paced, evolving environments.

jobs.title: HR Business Partner
jobs.description:
Vill du vara med och utveckla framtidens HR i en samhällsviktig verksamhet?

HR Business Partner till Teracom

På Teracom arbetar vi med något som många tar för givet – men som är avgörande när det verkligen gäller. Vi ansvarar för robust och säker kommunikationsinfrastruktur som bidrar till att hålla Sverige uppkopplat och är en viktig del av landets beredskap och totalförsvar.

Nu söker vi en erfaren och engagerad HR Business Partner som vill bidra till att utveckla människor, ledarskap och organisation i ett bolag med ett viktigt samhällsuppdrag. Hos oss får du en bred och verksamhetsnära roll där du kombinerar strategiskt utvecklingsarbete med operativt chefsstöd – i ett HR-team med hög kompetens, stort förtroende och en kultur som präglas av ansvar, innovation och mod.

Om rollen

Som HR Business Partner är du en nära partner till våra chefer genom hela medarbetarresan – från rekrytering och introduktion till utveckling, förändring och avslut. Du arbetar både operativt och strategiskt och är ett kvalificerat stöd inom bland annat arbetsrätt, arbetsmiljö, rehabilitering, ledarskap, kultur, organisationsutveckling och förändringsledning.

En viktig del av uppdraget handlar om att tillsammans med verksamheten säkerställa Teracoms långsiktiga kompetensförsörjning. I takt med att teknik, säkerhetskrav och omvärlden förändras behöver vi fortsätta attrahera, utveckla och behålla rätt kompetens. Du bidrar aktivt till att utveckla gemensamma HR-processer och arbetssätt.

Det här är en roll för dig som vill påverka på riktigt. HR är en självklar strategisk partner på Teracom, och som HR Business Partner får du möjlighet att bidra i frågor som är avgörande för verksamhetens framtid.

Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden

• Vara ett kvalificerat stöd och coach till chefer i både operativa och strategiska HR-frågor.
• Driva och utveckla HR-processer genom hela medarbetarresan.
• Arbeta med kompetensförsörjningsfrågor såsom rekrytering och bemanningsfrågor.
• Vidare även introduktion, arbetsrätt, rehabilitering och arbetsmiljö, ledarskap, organisationsutveckling och employer branding.
• Stötta och utveckla chefer i ledarskapsfrågor.
• Tillsammans med HR-teamet fortsätta utveckla HR-funktionen.

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som är en erfaren HR Business Partner och trivs i en bred roll där du får kombinera operativt arbete med strategisk utveckling. Du är trygg i din HR-kompetens, skapar förtroendefulla relationer och har ett konsultativt förhållningssätt. Du uppskattar att coacha chefer, utmana när det behövs och hitta lösningar som skapar värde för verksamheten.

Som person är du prestigelös, nyfiken och lösningsorienterad. Du har hög integritet, gott omdöme och ett genuint engagemang för människor. Samtidigt arbetar du strukturerat, tar ansvar och driver frågor från idé till genomförande.

Vi tror att du har:

• Akademisk utbildning inom HR eller motsvarande.
• Minst 6-års erfarenhet som HR Business Partner eller i en liknande bred HR-roll.
• Goda kunskaper inom arbetsrätt och arbetsmiljö.
• Erfarenhet av att coacha och utveckla chefer.
• Erfarenhet av strategisk kompetensförsörjning och rekrytering.
• Erfarenhet av lönebildningsprocesser.
• God förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska i tal och skrift.

Du blir en del av vårt HR-team

Du rapporterar till HR-direktören och blir en del av en HR-funktion där vi arbetar nära varandra och tillsammans skapar värde för verksamheten. Teamet består av två HR Business Partners som tillsammans stöttar hela verksamheten, en arbetsmiljöspecialist och två kollegor inom lön, ersättning och förmåner.

Vi är ett litet team med hög kompetens, korta beslutsvägar och ett prestigelöst samarbete där vi delar kunskap, hjälper varandra och utvecklas tillsammans.

Därför ska du välja Teracom

Hos Teracom får du använda din HR-kompetens i en verksamhet där den verkligen gör skillnad. Du får arbeta nära affären, påverka verksamhetens utveckling och bidra till ett samhällsviktigt uppdrag tillsammans med engagerade kollegor

Overview

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.

You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.

Come make an impact every day at Zebra.

What We're Looking For

As a Senior People Partner, you will be a vital pillar of our People Team, providing strategic guidance and hands-on support to leaders and employees alike. You will deliver impactful people services by leveraging your deep understanding of local talent, policies, and core HR programs. In this role, you will champion our company culture, drive employee engagement, and serve as the true voice of the employees in your region. We are looking for a people-centric, highly effective communicator who is passionate about fostering a positive, inclusive, and high-performing work environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Strategic Advising: Guide and coach managers on talent decisions, organizational changes, and team development.
• Talent Strategy: Partner with Talent Strategy Partners on organizational design, restructuring, and succession planning.
• Employee Advocacy: Keep a pulse on regional employee sentiment and trends, acting as the true voice of our people.
• Employee Relations: Manage employee relations, conduct internal investigations, and advise managers on performance issues.
• Performance & Culture: Enable managers to lead performance cycles, talent reviews, and action plans for engagement surveys.
• COE Collaboration: Work with Centres of Excellence (COEs) to execute regional talent processes and key initiatives.
• HR Digitalization: Support self-service adoption and automation to improve overall employee service delivery.
• Compliance: Oversee local HR compliance, policies, and reporting to ensure alignment with labour laws.

Qualifications

• Experience: 5+ years of HR experience, with a focus on employee relations and manager coaching (as an HR Generalist or HRBP).
• Languages: Fluent in English and Czech Language
• Relationship Management: Strong communication skills with a proven track record of building trust with employees and leaders.
• ER & Compliance: Deep understanding of Czech labour law and local compliance practices.
• Problem Solving: Ability to navigate complex, non-routine situations and deliver creative, practical solutions.
• Execution & Agility: Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and execute in a fast-paced environment.
• Conflict Resolution: Excellent facilitation skills to constructively resolve workplace issues.
• Data & Analytics: Capable of interpreting HR metrics to drive talent decisions.
• HR Tech: Proficient in HR systems, ideally Workday and ServiceNow.

Benefits

• 5 weeks of vacation, 5 sick days and 2 volunteer days paid off.
• Multisport card at a reduced price.
• Meal contribution.
• Monthly contribution of 1000 CZK/month in the form of credits on your Benefit plus card with cafeteria system where you can choose from a wide range of activities/benefits from Health, Sports, Travel, Wellness, Development, Culture up to company Language courses.
• Training and personal development in soft skills and hard skills, access to our internal learning portal and internal career opportunities within Zebra departments.
• Annual bonuses based on financial results.
• Yearly salary increases according to individual performance.
• Employee referral bonus for bringing New Talen

jobs.title: Compensation & Benefits Manager, APAC
jobs.description:
The TP ICAP Group is a world leading provider of market infrastructure.

Our purpose is to provide clients with access to global financial and commodities markets, improving price discovery, liquidity, and distribution of data, through responsible and innovative solutions.

Through our people and technology, we connect clients to superior liquidity and data solutions.

The Group is home to a stable of premium brands. Collectively, TP ICAP is the largest interdealer broker in the world by revenue, the number one Energy & Commodities broker in the world, the world’s leading provider of OTC data, and an award winning all-to-all trading platform.

The Group operates from more than 60 offices in 27 countries. We are 5,300 people strong. We work as one to achieve our vision of being the world’s most trusted, innovative, liquidity and data solutions specialist.

Role Overview

Reporting to the Group Head of Reward, in London, this role has the responsibility for managing reward, compensation and benefits for the APAC region. As such, we are looking for a strong and experienced individual to join our global team.

Role Responsibilities

This role plays a critical role in developing and implementing compensation and rewards strategies to attract, motivate, and retain top talent across the organization. You will collaborate with key stakeholders, including HR business partners, finance, and senior leadership, to design and administer competitive compensation and rewards programmes that align with business goals and support our commitment to employee engagement and performance.

• Provide guidance and support to HR business partners and managers on compensation-related matters, including job levelling, salary bands, and incentive plans.
• Monitor market trends and legislative changes related to compensation and benefits, providing recommendations and ensuring compliance with local and global regulations.

• Collaborate with the HRIS team to maintain and update compensation data and systems, ensuring accuracy and data integrity.
• Analyse compensation and rewards data to identify trends, patterns, and areas for improvement, and provide actionable insights to senior management.
• Drive the communication and education of compensation and benefits programs, ensuring employees have a clear understanding of the total rewards offerings available to them.

jobs.title: Human Resources Generalist (Part-time)
jobs.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

As an HR Generalist you will be responsible for a variety of Human Resources tasks or programs, including advising people managers on the execution of performance management, coaching, corrective action issues, team building, employee development and compliance programs. You will provide primary operational (daily) support for our managers and employees. We ask that you have team participation and interfaces within all areas of Human Resources to provide support for managers and employees. The HRG will also help expand the HR presence throughout the organization and also supporting culture shifts through targeted programs.

You will report to the HR Manager Italy & Israel and have a hybrid and part time schedule working in Israel (Netanja or Holon).

Your Responsibilities

• Partner with HRBPs, CoEs leaders at a local level to bring value and support to the business through: execution of performance management, coaching, corrective action issues, team building, employee development, compliance programs, execution of university relations programs/activities.
• Provide feedback to HRBPs, COEs and HR Services to assist those functions to deliver continuous improvement and consistency to all employees.
• Local deployment support of HR programs (ex. Implementing new payroll methods locally, SAP implementation, launching new CoE program, others).
• Deliver HR training activities provided by the COEs or HR Services to managers and employees.
• Partner with HRBP and Legal on execution employee investigations.
• Provide regional benefits support when needed.
• Provide support for local languages and data gathering when site specific identified.
• Require data for local activities when needed: tax audit, investigation, invoice data entry, legal review, EHS, compensation guidance, represent company in employee dispute.
• Manage, with input from hiring manager, all voluntary terminations, reductions in force. This includes planning, costing, and documenting all stages of the exit (with the support from HRBPs).
• Ensure, when site specific, all local policies and procedures are up to date along with any transition needed according to local legal requirements.
• Provide guidance to local managers on performance management to prevent employee disputes.
• Provide support for on-site audit/compliance reviews (regulatory/legal requirements). Comply with local laws related to ensuring a positive, non-discriminatory and safe work environment. These changes may include reviewing policies, procedures, handbooks and employment documents.
• Provide support for any company-wide changes or programs, such as employee development, restructuring, support HRBPs with organizational design and change management efforts.
• Provide local support for corporate programs, such as engagement and inclusion programs, global voices (employee survey) and action planning.

The Essentials - You Will Have

• Minimum 3 years' human resources experience, including direct, hands-on experience managing employment issues.
• Solid knowledge of local labor law.
• Experience working in diverse lines within a global matrix organization.
• Very good command of English (written and spoken) and local language.
• Bachelor's Degree within Human Resources, Business, or related.

The Preferred - You

jobs.title: Training Specialist
jobs.description:
Description

Paragon is a fast-growing Tel Aviv based cyber intelligence company, that is rapidly establishing itself as a key player in the industry. We are an innovative company with a cutting-edge product.

We are looking for a highly skilled Training Specialist to join our team!

This role combines instructional design with presentation delivery and is ideal for someone who is equally comfortable writing documentation as they are leading a session.As a Training Specialist you will be responsible for curating training materials by working closely with Product and Marketing Managers to translate complex product features into clear accessible learning content. In addition, you will serve as an instructor and deliver the curated material in engaging face-to-face or remote sessions to customers and colleges from other teams.

Responsibilities

Content Development

• Collaborate with Product Managers, technical experts and other stakeholders to understand new product features and workflows
• Curate training content including user guides, presentations, step-by-step tutorials and supporting documentation
• Maintain and update content to reflect the ongoing product development
• Ensure consistency, clarity, and high linguistic quality in all materials
• Participate in the design of the Company’s learning strategy

Instruction & Delivery

• Lead training sessions (remote or on-site) for clients and Company colleges
• Present complex information in a clear, engaging, and digestible format
• Adjust training approach based on the audience’s needs and feedback
• Maintain and manage the training environment and products

Program Management

• Design structured training programs (e.g., onboarding, certifications, role-based learning tracks)
• Track participation, gather feedback, and analyse training effectiveness
• Suggest and implement improvements to training processes and tools

Requirements

• 3+ years experience of hands-on face-to-face and remote training instruction, with proven experience standing and delivering content in front of an audience - a must
• Native-level written English with strong grammar skills – a must
• Native or fluent spoken English- a must
• Ability to translate complex technical topics into easy-to-understand language
• Proficiency in PowerPoint, Word, Google Slides, and LMS platforms.
• A proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop others is an advantage
• Experience working with Product or R&D teams – a plus
• Ability to work independently and as a part of a team
• Excellent time management skills
• Attentive to detail, self-learner, motivated, flexible, and proactive
• Willingness to travel extensively - up to 50% travel

jobs.title: Principal Compensation Analyst
jobs.description:
Description

Principal Compensation Analyst

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

• Conduct comprehensive market research using external salary surveys (e.g., Mercer, Radford) to gather data on competitor compensation practices for various job roles.
• Analyze market trends and identify industry benchmarks to assess company competitiveness.
• Conduct ad-hoc market analysis to support specific compensation initiatives.
• Clean, manipulate, and analyze large datasets from multiple sources to generate actionable insights aligned to business strategy.
• Develop detailed reports and presentations showcasing compensation trends, market positioning, and recommendations for salary adjustments.
• Maintain salary ranges based on market data in alignment with company strategy.
• Annually review survey participation and budget and make recommendations for changes.
• Manage the annual survey matching process. Own the relationship with our survey providers. Maintain and enhance our market database.
• Explore new ways of working leveraging AI in benchmarking.

Qualification Requirements

• BA/BS degree in Human Resources, Business, Finance, or related field
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and data analysis tools
• Experience with compensation survey platforms
• Experience with Payfactors is a plus
• Strong understanding of compensation principles and best practices
• Ability to interpret complex data and translate insights into actionable recommendations
• Knowledge of industry trends and competitive landscape
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills to effectively present findings to senior management and HR stakeholders
• Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams

Today, more people than ever are speaking publicly about their mental health. Whether it's ourselves, our friends and family or even public figures, taking care of your behavioral health is no longer a taboo, it's vital, and it's only human.

Eleos is on a mission to help deliver the world's most effective behavioral care through data, measurement, and personalization. Or simply put, we want to give clinicians the support they need to do the important work only they can do.

What is the Opportunity?

This is a hands-on role with broad exposure and responsibility, and plenty of room to learn, grow, and improve how we work. Alongside the day-to-day operations, you’ll have the opportunity to shape better processes, strengthen our data, and use automation and AI to make the People team smarter, faster, and more effective.

The role combines 3 main areas: employee lifecycle and HR operations, office and facilities management, and continuous process improvement. Approximately 40% of the role will focus on managing our Tel Aviv office, while the rest will focus on supporting employees and managers, running HR processes, and finding better ways to work.

You’ll work closely with our People Partners, Talent Acquisition, Organizational Development, Finance, Legal, and global People teams.

What you’ll do

HR operations and employee support

• Support employees throughout the full lifecycle, including onboarding, employment changes, parental leave, benefits, internal mobility, and offboarding.
• Serve as a trusted point of contact for employees and managers on policies, procedures, and HR-related questions.Coordinate HR processes with care, accuracy, and attention to detail.
• Maintain employee records, HRIS data, documentation, policies, and internal resources.
• Partner with People Partners and Organizational Development on organizational changes, compensation processes, performance cycles, engagement, and talent initiatives.
• Partner with Talent Acquisition to create a smooth transition from candidate to employee, including offers, onboarding, and the day-one experience.
• Work with Finance, Legal, and our external payroll provider on payroll, benefits, and employment compliance.

Office and facilities management

• Manage the day-to-day operation of our Tel Aviv office.
• Own relationships with vendors and service providers, including maintenance, supplies, catering, cleaning, and facilities.
• Support company activities, celebrations, events, and employee gatherings.
• Make sure the office remains welcoming, organized, well maintained, and ready for the team.
• Identify opportunities to improve the office environment and the way we manage it.

Process improvement, data, and AI

• Regularly review how we work and identify ways to make People and office processes simpler, faster, and more effective.
• Improve workflows, documentation, tools, and handoffs across the People team.Maintain clean, reliable data and build practical reports that support better decisions.
• Use AI and automation to reduce repetitive work, improve accuracy, and create better processes.
• Bring common sense, curiosity, creativity, and constructive challenge to the way things are done.

What you’ll bring

• 2–4 years of experience in HR Operations, People Operations, HR administration, office management, or an HR Generalist role.
• Experience supporting employee lifecycle processes and office operations.
• Strong ownership and follow-through. You take responsibility from beginning to end and care about getting the details right.
• A genuine service mindset and the ability to support employees with care, professionalism, and sound judgment.
• Curiosity about AI, automation, and new tools.
• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage several priorities at the same time.
• Working knowledge of Israeli labor law, payroll, benefits, and employment compliance.
• Experience working with an HRIS, or a similar platform.Strong Excel or G

This role sits at the heart of our HR operations - owning the day-to-day employee’s employment life cycle, from onboarding through offboarding, while helping connect our local processes with global People Operations standards.

You'll be part of the IL People Team and work closely with our global People Ops team to align local practices with company-wide processes, and make sure that what we do here in Israel is consistent with how things work across the organization - while also reflecting local needs and requirements.

What You’ll Do

Employee Lifecycle Management

• Manage onboarding and offboarding processes
• Handle employment changes such as promotions, transfers, and role or salary updates
• Maintain employee files and employment documentation
• Manage vacation, leave of absence, and parental leave processes

HR Data, Systems & Global Alignment

• Own and maintain our HRIS systems
• Manage user permissions and access within HR systems
• Prepare and issue HR documents
• Work cross-functionally with teams like Finance on topics such as payroll, insurance, and benefits
• Liaise with external vendors, including insurance providers
• Support the implementation of global People Operations processes locally, helping bridge between global standards and local practice
• Generate reports and analyze HR data

Process Improvement

• Monitor and maintain HR policies and procedures
• Identify opportunities for automation and process efficiency
• Involvement in cross-organizational projects within People Operations

Who You Are

• 2-3 years of experience in HR Operations / People Operations from Tech Company
• Experience working with HRIS systems
• Strong proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets
• Strong data analysis and reporting skills
• Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple tasks at once
• High level of English
• Ability to work across multiple stakeholders and interfaces
• Strong organizational skills, excellent interpersonal abilities, strong communication skills, team player, and a high sense of ownership and responsibility

About HUMAN Security

HUMAN was founded in a Brooklyn sci-fi bookstore with a hacker mindset and the lofty mission of making the internet safer by putting humans first. Today, our Human Defense Platform safeguards enterprises from sophisticated bots, fraud, and account abuse, verifying the humanity of more than 20 trillion interactions per week for the world’s biggest brands and internet platforms.

HUMAN is an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to protecting the internet's integrity for everyone. We believe in putting people first, embracing diversity of thought from our global teams, and welcoming all individuals to share their unique experiences as we fight cybercrime together. We support our Humans with a comprehensive total rewards package for personal and professional development, including well-being and learning stipends, flexible work options, and dedicated time off. While our HQ is in NYC, we have teams worldwide.

HUMAN is growing fast, and there’s never been a more meaningful time to join us. If you thrive on solving complex problems and want to help shape the future of cybersecurity, join us as we build a safer, more human internet.

If you are an individual with a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us directly.

At our core is LTX-2, an open-source generative video model, built to deliver expressive, high-fidelity video at unmatched speed. It powers both our own products and a growing ecosystem of partners through API integration.

The company is also known globally for pioneering consumer creativity through products like Facetune, one of the world’s most recognized creative brands, which helped introduce AI-powered visual expression to hundreds of millions of users worldwide. We combine deep research, user-first design, and end-to-end execution from concept to final render, to bring the future of expression to all.

We're looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Partner - R&D who's genuinely curious about AI and technology, knows how to earn the trust of technical leaders, navigates ambiguity with confidence, and pushes hiring processes forward.

What you will be doing

• Own the full recruiting lifecycle for global R&D roles across Engineering, Research, Data, and Product teams in Israel, the UK, and the US.
• Partner closely with R&D leadership and hiring managers to define hiring strategy, calibrate talent profiles, and advise on market realities.
• Lead proactive sourcing strategies to identify and engage exceptional passive talent, with a strong emphasis on the AI/ML, deep learning, and generative AI ecosystem.
• Drive structured, fast-moving hiring processes with clear stakeholder communication, sharp prioritization, and zero drop-off in candidate care.
• Leverage AI-powered tools to build smarter, more efficient recruiting workflows.
• Identify friction points in the hiring process and lead the implementation of solutions - treating recruitment operations with the same rigor you'd expect from an engineering team.
• Partner with the HR team to drive initiatives that strengthen manager capabilities, elevate the candidate journey, and contribute to an exceptional employee experience across the organization.

Your Skills And Experience

• 7+ years of full-cycle technical recruiting experience, ideally in a high-growth AI, deep tech company.
• Prior experience recruiting AI/ML researchers is a strong advantage.
• Strong sourcing capabilities and a proactive, pipeline-first mindset.
• A true business partner mindset - you know how to build trust with senior technical leaders, challenge assumptions when needed, and move hiring decisions forward with confidence.
• Deep fluency in the R&D talent landscape: you can hold a credible conversation about ML research, platform engineering, or data infrastructure, and you know what separates a strong signal from noise in a technical profile.
• Hands-on experience using generative AI tools to enhance recruiting workflows.
• High organizational intelligence - able to balance multiple searches, shifting priorities, and demanding stakeholders without losing quality or speed.

Why Join Us:

We’re here to push the boundaries of what’s possible with AI and video - not for the buzz, but for the craft, the challenge, and the chance to make something genuinely new.

We believe in an environment where people are encouraged to think, create and explore. Real impact happens when people are empowered to experiment, evolve, and elevate together.

jobs.description:
Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

About The People Team

The People team helps Affirmers cultivate a high-performing, inclusive organization. We focus on three core areas: attracting talent aligned to our mission, enabling growth through people and team development, and retaining employees through thoughtful experiences and rewards. We develop Affirm’s people programs and systems to create a workplace where all employees can thrive and contribute meaningfully. By investing in our people, we create a long-term advantage for the business.

About The Role

We are seeking a detail oriented and analytically sound Compensation Lead to own the end-to-end management of our compensation systems. You will be responsible for ensuring systems like Radford (survey reporting) and Pave (cycle management) are set up to support Affirm’s policies, procedures, and employees. In this role you will play a key role in the day to day compensation operations and ensuring our programs are effective and competitive.

What You’ll Do

• Manage the end-to-end administration of our semiannual compensation processes
• Develop and participate in all components of our annual compensation studies to evaluate Affirm’s competitive market positioning, including: auditing roles (responsibilities, activities, duties, and requirements), job responsibilities, activities, duties and requirements, leading our benchmarking survey submission/review process, and evaluating/recommending updates to our cash and equity compensation structures/ranges
• Conduct special projects for ad hoc compensation analyses across a variety of areas, including incentive compensation, equity programs, and pay equity analyses
• Own the pay reporting process for the various geographies Affirm supports
• Assist with compensation training and communications

What We Look For
• 5+ years of experience in compensation or people analytics
• Experience with compensation management systems (with a strong preference towards Pave)
• Passion for working with data and an analytical mindset to turn raw data into actionable insights using various tools (Excel / Google Sheets, Sigma Computing, Claude Code, etc.)
• Attention to detail, strong sense of responsibility and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively
• Strong team orientation with collaborative style; ability to work effectively across internal teams, communicating clearly and comprehensively to meet project deadlines
• Leads with strong judgment and integrity; able to maturely handle sensitive and confidential information
• Proven ability to work on problems of diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors
• Highly effective verbal and written communications skills; ability to distill complex concepts/information to employees and Senior Leaders in a digestible manner
• Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple high, and potentially shifting, priorities in a fast-paced environment
• Strong customer service background
• Knowledge of regulatory requirements and the ability to establish and maintain compliance of all plans and programs

Pay Grade - K

Equity Grade - 4

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

CAN base pay range per year: $112,000 - $172,000

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

As a global energy technology leader, we're accelerating the energy evolution through purposeful innovation and trusted partnerships. Join Team Green and help shape the future of intelligent energy.

For our Global Rewards team at our company headquarters in Cham, near Zug, we are seeking an Expert, Compensation (Global Rewards). In this full-time role, you will play a pivotal part in further shaping our global compensation strategy, driving the global rewards agenda, and ensuring competitive, equitable, and compliant compensation practices across the organization.

What will your day/week look like with us:

Support executive and Board remuneration activities, including preparation of Remuneration Committee materials and the annual compensation report in line with Swiss listed company requirements

Attractive perks and discounts (insurance, mobile plans, leisure activities, fleet offers)

Continuous learning opportunities (including LinkedIn Learning)

Full-time

Exempt

Job Summary

Pay Range: $59,000 - $116,000

Note: Individuals typically begin between the minimum to middle of the pay range

Support and assist with the design, development and administration of our corporate compensation philosophy, strategy, and employee salary administration programs. Administers the job description process to include evaluating submitted documents and determining appropriate job leveling. Conduct research and analysis to determine HMSA's competitive market position regarding our total compensation package. Work with key business partners to consult on job design and compensation strategies.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree and two years of related experience or equivalent combination of education and experience.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
• Basic working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications. Including but not limited to Word, Excel, and Outlook.

Duties And Responsibilities

Job Description Evaluation:

• Administers job description process: Reviews job evaluation requests for new or revised job descriptions to determine appropriate job leveling and FLSA exemption status. Utilizes job evaluation criteria and available salary market data.
• Reviews job description content, evaluation questionnaires and job equity guidelines to ensure evaluation methodology and criteria are applied consistently and objectively.
• Reviews the job qualification requirements to ensure appropriate alignment with comparable jobs and to meet legal and compliance considerations.
• Maintains documentation and related attributes in database

Salary Administration

• Administers HMSA's compensation programs including base pay, variable pay, bonuses, special recognition, and most forms of cash compensation. Ensures salary actions are within established guidelines and align with HMSA's pay philosophy.
• Develops reports and reviews salary data to conduct internal salary equity analysis.
• Assists in the development of annual salary structure proposal(s). Reviews and adjusts the Merit Increase Matrix Guidelines based on projected salary administration budget and planned business objectives.

Project Participation

• Participates on various departmental projects and may play a leadership role on various small projects.

Consultation

• Provides leaders with consultative advice/information on compensation strategies and action plans for staff members, career path development, and strategic job development and alignment.

Market Evaluation

• Participate in salary surveys to assist management in determining the organization's competitive market position.
• Identify benchmark job matches.
• Collect and organize salary data.
• Analyze survey results, internal and external salary statistics to support and validate salary adjustment proposals/recommendations.

Other Duties/Functions

• Performs all other miscellaneous responsibilities and duties as assigned or directed.

This role combines HR operations, employee experience, recruitment coordination, and administrative responsibilities, playing a key role in ensuring smooth day-to-day operations and a positive employee experience.

Human Resources

• Handle onboarding and offboarding processes for new hires and departing employees

Administrative

jobs.description:
About The Position

Coralogix is a modern, full-stack observability platform transforming how businesses process and understand their data. Our unique architecture powers in-stream analytics without reliance on expensive indexing or hot storage. We specialize in comprehensive monitoring of logs, metrics, traces, and security events with features like APM, RUM, SIEM, Kubernetes monitoring, and more—enhancing operational efficiency and reducing observability costs by up to 70%.

We seek a talented, passionate, and experienced HRBP to join our one-of-a-kind HR team.

What You’ll Do

• Trusted Advisor & Coaching: Serve as a trusted advisor to managers, providing coaching and consultancy to further develop their leadership skills and teams.
• Process Ownership: Hands-on ownership and execution HR processes.
• Talent Management: Lead talent management and development initiatives to support high employee engagement and retention.
• Project Execution: Lead and execute various projects and initiatives focused on talent development, employee engagement, and performance management.
• Program Evaluation: Measure the business impact of programs and continuously refine content based on feedback and organizational needs.
• Change Management & Communication: Drive processes and effective communication, ensuring a clear line of sight between employees daily activities and company strategy.
• Legal Compliance: Maintain expertise in Israel's employment law and ensure local and global compliance across supported locations.
• Cross-Functional Partnering: Partner effectively with HR's main functional areas (e.g., Hiring, Employee Experience, and Compensation).

Requirements

• Availability to work on-site at our Ramat Gan office 4 days per week.
• 4+ years of experience as an HRBP, including employee relations, training and development, performance management, benefits, compensation, compliance, and recruiting)
• Degree in Human Resources, Psychology, or a similar relevant field
• Experience in fast-paced environments with a collaborative and commercial approach.
• Strong communication, interpersonal, and coaching skills.
• Can-do attitude with a positive mindset.

Cultural Fit

We’re seeking candidates who are hungry, humble, and smart. Coralogix fosters a culture of innovation and continuous learning, where team members are encouraged to challenge the status quo and contribute to our shared mission. If you thrive in dynamic environments and are eager to shape the future of observability solutions, we’d love to hear from you.

Coralogix is an equal opportunity employer and encourages applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.title: Senior HR Business Partner
jobs.description:
Despre client

Resort premium din Cluj-Napoca, cu vedere panoramică asupra orașului. Un loc unde cazarea de lux, gastronomia rafinată, evenimentele de excepție și un SPA de tip Aesthetics, Wellbeing & Longevity se îmbină într-o experiență completă. Mai mult decât un hotel, un reper al excelenței, aflat într-un moment captivant de creștere și transformare.

Despre rol
Căutăm un specialist în dezvoltare organizațională și transformare care vrea să fie arhitectul unui sistem, nu cineva care administrează HR. Dacă ai însoțit organizații prin schimbare, știi să construiești cultură și ești genul de persoană la care oamenii vin cu adevărat, acesta este locul tău.

Profilul tău, pe scurt:
• Mentalitate de cauciuc: ești rezilient, persistent, nu te blochezi în fricțiuni organizaționale, știi că schimbarea durează și o accepți
• Puternic și blând simultan: dai feedback direct fără să rănești, influențezi fără autoritate formală, ești prezent în conversațiile dificile
• Mesager de încredere: oamenii vin la tine, CEO-ul se consultă cu tine, nu ești „omul HR-ului", ești partenerul de business al echipei
• Focus pe OD, nu pe recrutare: specializarea ta principală este development organizațional, change management, L&D, nu HR Admin sau talent acquisition
• Diplomat în conversații dificile: ai tact fără a pierde substanța mesajului, nu ești abrupt, lași timp oamenilor să proceseze
• Direct și răbdător simultan: spui lucrurilor pe nume, dar lași timp oamenilor să se schimbe; ești ferm dar empatic
• Payroll Budget Owner: responsabil de bugetul de salarii, compensații și beneficii
• Experiență: min. 10 ani în HR/OD, din care 3+ ani în rol de coordonare.

Obiectivele tale:
• O organizație care performează prin sistem și cultură, nu prin efortul câtorva persoane-cheie.
• Sistem de evaluare a performanței: construiești cadrul de evaluare la nivel de organizație, echipă de management și individual
• Criterii de performanță: definești KPI și criterii clare pe fiecare rol din structura
• Cadru de review recurent: lunar pentru management, trimestrial pentru echipe, primul ciclu complet coordonat de tine
• Planificarea schimbării organizaționale: alături de Board of Advisors și Management Team, ghidezi tranziția
• Coeziunea echipei de management: 4 lideri noi instalați simultan, tu ești liantul
• Cultura organizațională: definești valorile, comportamentele, așteptările și ritualurile interne
• Program de mentorat: linie de succesiune GM pe termen mediu, tu construiești planul de dezvoltare

Despre oferta
• Pachet salarial competitiv, corelat cu senioritarea rolului
• Bonus legat de obiective organizaționale (de definit în primele luni)
• Masă în locație, acces la facilitățile resortului, pachet de onboarding

De ce GetFrankly?
La GetFrankly ghidăm talentul și creăm viitor.
Înțelegem că o schimbare în carieră nu este doar despre un nou rol, ci este despre găsirea unui loc în care abilitățile, ambițiile și valorile tale se aliniază.

Sună-ne pentru a discuta despre ceea ce este important pentru cariera și viitorul tău, iar noi vom face tot posibilul să te implicăm în proiecte interesante și să-ți oferim opțiuni de carieră împlinitoare.

Te vom ghida către mediul potrivit în care abilitățile tale vor prospera și vor avea un impact semnificativ.

• Works comfortably under pressure and meets tight deadlines.
• Strategic and yet meticulous with ability for attending to details.

• Can-do attitude, driven, and able to perform under pressure.
• Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

• Post Graduate in Human Resources Management or related degree with managerial experience.

Koetko, että HR:n paikka ei ole liiketoiminnan taustalla vaan sen ytimessä?
Nautitko työskentelystä dynaamisessa ja tavoitehakuisessa ympäristössä?
Haluatko olla mukana rakentamassa voittajakulttuuria?
Jatka lukemista. Saatat olla etsimämme HR Business Partner!

Tervetuloa JYSKiin!
Tämä on harvoin tarjolla oleva ja strategisesti tärkeä rooli, jolla on suora vaikutus noin 500 JYSKin työntekijän arkeen ympäri Suomen. JYSK ei ole ainoastaan menestyksekäs perheyritys ja globaali vähittäiskaupan edelläkävijä, vaan myös yksi Suomen parhaista työnantajista. Se osoittaa, että korkea suorituskyky ja työtyytyväisyys voivat kulkea käsi kädessä.

Kansainvälisessä vertailussa JYSK on ansainnut paikkansa kolmella maailman arvostetuimmalla työnantajalistalla. Vuonna 2025 Forbes, Fortune ja TIME Magazine ovat kaikki tunnustaneet JYSKin yhdeksi maailman parhaista työnantajista ja yrityksistä.

Miksi HR Business Partnerin rooli on tärkeä?
JYSKissä HR on aito liiketoimintafunktio. Työtä tehdään saumattomassa yhteistyössä myymälätoimintojen eli Retailin kanssa, ja tavoite on kaikille yhteinen: olla asiakkaan ensisijainen valinta nukkumisen ja asumisen tuoteryhmissä. HR Business Partnerina toimit Retailin strategisena kumppanina ja teet aktiivisesti työtä JYSKin liiketoiminnan tarpeiden ja tavoitteiden eteen, oman erityisosaamisesi kautta.

Työn sisältö ja painopisteet
Toimit HR Business Partnerina myymäläorganisaatiolle, johon kuuluu 5 tai 6 aluetta, joista kussakin on keskimäärin 8 myymälää. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä aluepäälliköiden sekä heidän esihenkilönsä, Retail Managerin, kanssa. Työsi keskiössä ovat JYSKin HR-fokusalueet:

• Set the strongest teams – varmistat yhdessä aluepäälliköiden kanssa, että jokaisella alueella on parhaat tiimit.
• Secure strong talent pipeline – tuet esihenkilöitä vahvan seuraajasuunnitelman rakentamisessa ja ylläpitämisessä.
• Develop people and performance – valmennat, haastat ja tuet esihenkilöitä suorituksen johtamisessa.

Työskentelet laaja-alaisesti rekrytoinnin, kehittämisen, koulutusten, HR-tunnuslukujen sekä työhyvinvoinnin parissa. Kasvavassa ja kehittyvässä yrityksessä erityisesti Talent ja Performance Management ovat tärkeitä teemoja, ja tuetkin esihenkilöitä aktiivisesti niiden parissa.
Olet näkyvä kumppani esihenkilöille ja läsnä myymälöissä, jotta HR-työkalut ja -konseptit juurtuvat arkeen. Työhön kuuluukin säännöllistä matkustamista erityisesti myymälöihin (2–4 pv/vko) sekä satunnaisia matkoja ulkomaille.

Mitä odotamme sinulta
• Kokemusta vaativista HR-tehtävistä (erityisesti HRD), mieluiten vähittäiskaupan kaltaisessa dynaamisessa toimintaympäristössä. Myös vahva retail-johtamisen tausta esimerkiksi aluepäällikön roolissa, yhdistettynä aitoon haluun kehittyä HR-tehtävässä voidaan ottaa huomioon
• Halua kehittää ja kehittyä
• Kykyä edistää HR-agendalla olevia asioita esihenkilöiden kautta, erityisesti etänä johtaen
• Valmiutta johtaa suoritusta ja kehittää ihmisiä tavoitteellisesti
• Hyviä vaikuttamis- ja viestintätaitoja sekä rohkeutta haastaa ja valmentaa kollegoita eri organisaatiotasoilla
• Valmiutta johtaa tiedolla, HR-dataa hyödyntäen
• Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa
• Valmiutta matkustaa säännöllisesti Suomessa ja ajoittain ulkomailla (2-4 päivää viikoittain)
• Ajokorttia ja MS Office -osaamista.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle
• Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa suuren yrityksen liiketoimintaan, sillä HR:n työ JYSKissä on todella merkityksellistä
• Kattavan perehdytyksen ja jatkuvaa tukea sekä paikalliselta HR-tiimiltä että kansainväliseltä konsernilta
• Ammattimaisen ja motivoituneen tiimin, jossa yhteistyö ja tuloksenteko kulkevat käsi kädessä

jobs.title: Senior People Partner
jobs.description:
At Six Robotics, we build intelligent software that gives Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) the ability to collaborate, adapt on the fly, and execute missions that were previously impossible. From our base in Oslo, our 70+ experts in defence, software, and AI develop our product, our flagship autonomy and swarm platform used by both government and industry. In close partnership with the Norwegian Defence Research Establishment (FFI), we move fast from concept to live deployment, often in the field alongside end users.

We work with advanced hardware and software, a modern tech stack, and missions that demand both technical mastery and operational discipline. Everyone is close to the action, from deep technical problem-solving to field operations. We move fast and value clarity, integrity, and teamwork in everything we do.

At Six Robotics, every person executes with precision, adapts to changing conditions, and strengthens the team. Getting in is hard, and you’ll be challenged every day. But if you have the skill, the discipline, and the drive to push your limits, you’ll find no better place to deliver real-world impact while collaborating and learning from the best in the field.

About The Role

We’ve grown rapidly over the past two years, hiring more than 50 people and building a team of 70+ today. As we continue scaling toward 120+ employees through 2026, growth will remain high, with hiring at a pace of 5+ new employees per month.

The challenge is no longer just attracting talent.

The challenge is building an organization that can keep up with that growth.

Until now, people responsibilities have largely been handled alongside recruitment and day-to-day needs. This has worked well at our current stage. As we continue to grow, we need to strengthen the structure behind the organization: how we develop leaders, define expectations, align around the mission, support high performance, and create clarity across teams.

We are entering a phase where the organization will evolve quickly, and that comes with increased complexity, new demands on leaders, and a greater need for alignment and consistency in how we operate and lead people.

We know that growth brings friction. The goal is not to avoid it entirely, but to handle it well; being prepared, addressing challenges early, and building in a way that allows the organization to scale without losing momentum.

That’s why we are hiring our first Senior People Partner.

This role is about helping us build the foundations needed to support a growing and ambitious company. You will work proactively to strengthen leadership, improve how we work with performance and feedback, and introduce the right level of structure as we scale.

A key part of the role is finding the right balance between building enough structure to support growth while maintaining the flexibility, speed, and ownership that define how we work. We will need clearer frameworks and ways of working, but without introducing unnecessary complexity. Our goal is to create an environment where people have the autonomy to make decisions, supported by the right tools and guidance to make good ones.

The role will report directly to the Head of People, and you will collaborate closely with Leadership, team leads, and Talent Acquisition to shape and develop the company moving forward.

What You Will Do

Because we are growing quickly, the exact priorities in this role will evolve. Things will change, new challenges will appear, and priorities will shift. Some problems will matter more than others depending on where we are in the journey.

We do not believe in defining a fixed list of responsibilities that may be outdated before you even start. Instead, this role is about identifying what matters most, focusing your effort where it has the highest impact, and helping the organization stay ahead as it grows.

Over your first 12 months, we expect you to contribute to outcomes like:

• Build a high-performance culture: Strengthen fe

About The Team

OpenAI's Compensation team plays a crucial role in rewarding and retaining world-class talent who will ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. By crafting and implementing innovative compensation strategies, we ensure our compensation offerings are competitive, equitable, and aligned with OpenAI's mission to scale intelligently and ethically.

About The Role

We are expanding our Compensation team and seeking a Compensation Business Partner to help build the compensation pillar for our go-to-market organization. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role for someone who brings deep GTM compensation expertise and enjoys turning evolving business needs into practical, scalable programs.

As a member of the total rewards team, you will partner closely with GTM leaders, HR Business Partners, Recruiting, Finance, and other cross-functional teams. You will spearhead compensation work across benchmarking, offer review, program design, and job architecture, with particular focus on the needs of a rapidly growing commercial organization.

The shape of the work will evolve as the business grows. At times, you may independently lead key initiatives from strategy through execution. At other times, you will work alongside additional compensation partners and cross-functional resources. Success in this role requires comfort operating with ambiguity, strong judgment, and a willingness to stay close to the details while building for scale.

This is an individual contributor role, designed for a subject-matter expert and hands-on builder.

In This Role, You Will

• Build and evolve compensation programs that support OpenAI’s growing GTM organization.
• Serve as a trusted compensation advisor to GTM leaders, HR Business Partners, Recruiting, and Finance.
• Lead compensation analysis and approval for offers, balancing market context, internal consistency, and OpenAI’s compensation philosophy.
• Own benchmarking and market analysis for GTM roles, translating insights into clear recommendations and scalable practices.
• Partner on the design and optimization of sales compensation programs, job architecture, and related compensation frameworks.
• Develop approaches that can flex with changing business priorities, organizational growth, and new talent needs.
• Move fluidly between strategic design and hands-on execution, including building processes and operating mechanisms where they do not yet exist.
• Collaborate with the broader Compensation team to share insights and strengthen company-wide programs.

You Might Thrive In This Role If You Have

• 6+ years of compensation experience, including meaningful depth supporting GTM or commercial organizations.
• Strong expertise in sales compensation, GTM benchmarking, and compensation program design.
• Experience building or materially evolving compensation programs in a fast-growing, dynamic organization.
• A builder mindset: you are energized by ambiguity and comfortable creating structure as the business evolves.
• Strong analytical judgment and the ability to translate complex data into practical recommendations.
• Excellent communication skills and the ability to build trust with senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners.
• The ability to work independently while collaborating closely with a broader team.

Location and Workplace

This role is based in our New York or San Francisco office and we aren’t considering remote applications at this time. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office with optional work from home on Thursdays and Fridays. We also offer relocation assistance to new employees.

Our open-plan offices have height-adjustable desks, conference rooms, phone booths, well-stocked kitchens full of snacks and drinks, three in-house prepared meals daily, outdoor space for working and socializing, wellness rooms, private bike storage, and more.

• Performs analysis, modeling, and calculations for annual bonuses, incentive programs and other ad hoc data requests

• Ability to maintain confidentiality around all different types of personal employee information.

We're looking for a Senior HR Business Partner & Employee Relations Specialist to own the people agenda for Finland and contribute to our Nordic HR strategy. This is a generalist role that shapes how we build the people infrastructure that lets a fast-scaling international company operate at its best.

You will work directly with senior leaders across functions, bring genuine Finnish labour law expertise to complex ER situations, and lead our push to embed AI-augmented HR practices into everyday workflows.

• Lead workforce planning and talent intelligence build forward-looking headcount models, identify skills gaps, and give leaders the data they need before they ask for it.

• Drive and execute organisational effectiveness initiatives lead restructuring, culture transformation, and change programmes from design through to delivery.
• Own the employee experience redesign the moments that matter using continuous feedback, journey mapping, and experimentation as an ongoing practice
• Collaborate across the Nordic & Europe HR team contribute to shared practices, regional benchmarking, and peer learning alongside HRBP counterparts in other markets.

What are we looking for?

• A credible, commercially aware HR Business Partner with 7+ years’ experience in HR, owning and delivering across multiple business units — not just supporting them.
• Ability to work autonomously and influence senior stakeholders, applying judgement that comes from years of operating at the intersection of people and business strategy
• Deep expertise in Finnish employment labour law, collective agreements and change negotiations.
• Proven experience in a fast-growth or international environment; SaaS, tech scale-up, or management consulting background strongly preferred.
• A track record of strategic partnering at leadership team level you have influenced decisions and have been part of or leading a transformational project

• Full professional fluency in both Finnish and English;

If you don’t tick every box above, don’t worry — we’re more interested in your potential

jobs.title: [쿠팡] 보상기획/운영 (Global Compensation)
jobs.description:
회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 리테일 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (Always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (High-tech), 초연결사회 (Hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

조직 소개

Total Rewards 산하 Comp Partner 팀은 시장 벤치마킹, 급여 범위 설계, 연간 및 수시 보상 조정 프로세스를 포함한 전사 보상 운영을 end-to-end로 관리합니다. 이 팀은 조직 전반에 걸쳐 보상 정책이 내부 형평성, 법적 준수, 명확한 커뮤니케이션을 충족하도록 설계 및 운영합니다. 또한 전략적 파트너로서, 빠르게 변화하는 환경 속에서 데이터 기반 인사이트를 제공하여 보상 관련 의사결정과 조직의 지속 가능한 성장을 지원합니다.

업무내용

• 담당 조직에 대한 end-to-end 보상 파트너십을 리드하고, 리더들에게 보상 의사결정 및 인재 투자 관련 자문 제공
• 시장 경쟁력과 내부 형평성을 반영한 급여 범위 설계 및 운영
• 연간 보상 사이클(급여 인상, 보너스, 승진)을 데이터 분석과 명확한 거버넌스를 기반으로 주도
• 시장 데이터 및 내부 분석을 활용한 전략적 보상 인사이트를 제공하여 비즈니스 및 HR 의사결정에 기여

자격요건

• 대기업 또는 테크 기반 조직에서 10년 이상의 Total Rewards 관련 경험
• 글로벌 이해관계자와 효과적으로 협업할 수 있는 우수한 영어 커뮤니케이션 역량
• 급여 모델링, 시장 벤치마킹, 데이터 기반 의사결정 경험을 포함한 뛰어난 분석 역량
• 보상 사이클(성과급, 보너스, 승진) 운영 및 급여 범위 관리 실무 경험
• 고급 수준의 Excel 및 데이터 분석 활용 능력

우대사항

• 글로벌 조직 또는 빠르게 성장하는 환경에서의 근무 경험
• Radford, Mercer 등 시장 벤치마크 툴에 대한 이해
• 비즈니스 전략과 보상 정책을 정렬할 수 있는 높은 비즈니스 감각

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

• 전형 절차
• 서류전형 - 채용담당자 전화인터뷰 - 전화인터뷰 - 화상(대면)면접 – 최종 합격
• 전형 절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
