jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Compensation
jobs.description:
Senior Analyst, Compensation (US & Canada)

IPEX is one of the North American leading providers of advanced plastic piping systems. Our mission is to shape a better tomorrow by connecting people with water and energy

We are seeking an experienced and analytical Senior Analyst, Compensation to play a critical role in the design, governance, and execution of compensation programs across the United States and Canada. Based out of our Oakville, ON office this role serves as a subject‑matter expert and trusted advisor, partnering closely with HR Business Partners, Total Rewards, and business leaders to ensure programs are competitive, compliant, and aligned with organizational strategy. This is a hybrid role 3 days/week on-site in Oakville.

The compensation for this position is between $81,300 and $101,600 annually, based on experience and qualifications.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead the execution and continuous improvement of compensation programs, including base pay, incentive, equity, and hourly wage programs.
• Serve as the primary lead for market pricing, conducting benchmarking analyses and recommending competitive pay ranges.
• Administer job architecture and job evaluation processes to ensure consistent leveling and internal equity.
• Lead pay equity audits for US and Canadian populations, identifying risks and recommending remediation strategies.
• Prepare and present compensation reports, dashboards, and insights for HR and leadership audiences.
• Provide wage costing and analytical support for collective bargaining negotiations.
• Develop complex compensation models, cost analyses, and scenario planning.
• Advise HR and business leaders on compensation decisions related to offers, promotions, retention, and organizational change.
• Monitor regulatory requirements and market trends to proactively enhance compensation programs.
• Partner with vendors and manage compensation tools and benchmarking platforms.
• Support implementation of new compensation tools, policies, and program enhancements.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or related field.
• CCP designation completed or in progress preferred.
• 5–7 years of progressive compensation experience, including exposure to US and Canadian markets.
• Strong knowledge of compensation legislation and pay equity requirements.
• Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, VLOOKUPs) and experience with HRIS systems.
• Demonstrated analytical, organizational, and problem‑solving skills.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to manage sensitive and confidential information.
• Bilingual English/French or English/Spanish is an asset.

IPEX is committed to providing accommodations for people with disabilities throughout the recruitment process and, upon request, will work with qualified job applicants to provide suitable accommodation in a manner that takes into account the applicant’s accessibility needs due to disability. Accommodation requests are available to candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process for IPEX jobs. To request an accommodation, please contact HR at HR@ipexna.com

jobs.title: Office Admin & Employee Experience
jobs.description:
Description

Join us at Nayax, a global fintech leader (NASDAQ; TASE: NYAX) revolutionizing the world of cashless payments, consumer engagement, and business management solutions. With more than 1,200 employees across 12 offices worldwide, Nayax is redefining how businesses interact with their customers.

At Nayax, you’ll be part of a diverse and innovative community where your work makes a real impact and helps shape the future of payments.

We are currently looking for an Office Admin & Employee Experience to join our team and play a key role in creating a positive and welcoming environment for our employees and guests, while ensuring smooth and efficient office operations.

The Office Admin & Employee Experience will report directly to the Office & HR Operations Manager.

The role is shift-based, with working hours either 08:00–17:00 or 11:00–20:00.

As part of the position, availability for 2–3 evening shifts (11:00–20:00) per week is required.

Your Key Responsibilities

• ﻿Be the welcoming face of Nayax, greeting visitors, candidates, and employees with professionalism and warmth.
• Act as the main point of contact for employees, suppliers, and external partners on all office-related matters.
• Manage daily office operations including supplies, food and beverages, parking, and facility coordination.
• Coordinate with building management and external vendors (cleaning, maintenance, security).
• Oversee workspace readiness: meeting rooms, common areas, and equipment availability.
• Manage office access cards, keys, and visitor registration.
• Support onboarding logistics for new employees (desk setup, badges).
• Track office budgets and vendor invoices
• Coordinate travel arrangements and accommodations for employees and guests.
• Handle incoming and outgoing mail, packages, and deliveries.
• Support the execution of welfare activities: happy hours, team events, celebrations, and holidays.
• Assist with sourcing and distributing gifts for employees (birthdays, holidays, anniversaries).
• Coordinate logistics for welfare events: catering, venues, supplies, and timing.

Requirements

What Makes You a Great Fit

• Proven experience as an Office Administrator, Front Desk Representative, or similar role.
• A proactive, service-oriented team player with a positive and friendly attitude.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Hebrew and English.
• Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Word).
• Strong interpersonal skills and good business judgment to work effectively with all levels of the organization.
• Availability to work evening shifts (11:00–20:00)

Nice-to-Have Skills

• Experience managing social media platforms (Facebook, Instagram, YouTube).
• Familiarity with Photoshop and/or Canva.

Why Join Nayax

• Take ownership of your work and make a real impact on our employees and company culture.
• Be part of a global fintech company that values innovation, teamwork, and excellence.
• Join a vibrant, dynamic, and supportive team that believes in collaboration and creativity.

Learn More About Nayax

Founded in 2005, Nayax provides an end-to-end platform for payments, empowers businesses to grow revenue, reduce operational costs, and deliver seamless commerce experiences. Our customer-first mindset and commitment to in-house innovation have positioned us at the forefront of the cashless payment revolution, serving the unattended and retail sectors around the world.

We support over 80 payment methods in 60+ currencies, hold a European payment institution license, and have formed strategic partnerships with global financial institutions to deliver powerful, scalable solutions.

With more than 1,200 employees across 12 global offices, Nayax operates in 120+ countries. Our global headquarters in Herzliya Hills, Israel, is our largest site, housing over 600 employees across 20+ departments

Who we are:

The 4M story is likely one you haven’t heard before: We are on a mission to unlock access to the world below us - to do for the world underground what Google Maps did for the world above. By leveraging cutting-edge technology, we are mapping the subsurface infrastructure to make reliable, real-time utility data accessible to the construction industry - completely transforming a traditional sector. We’re a growing startup with 120+ employees, based in Tel Aviv, Israel and Austin, Texas.

About the role:

We’re looking for an exceptional Senior People Partner to become a key force multiplier within our HR team.

This is not a classic HRBP role, nor a traditional HR Operations role. We’re looking for a true builder - someone who loves creating structure from scratch, improving the way things work, turning ideas into reality, and helping evolve a thoughtful, high-performing organization.

You’ll work closely with the HR team and key stakeholders on company-wide initiatives, OD processes, manager enablement, and strengthening the HR infrastructure of a growing global company.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced startup environments, combines strategic thinking with strong execution, navigates people dynamics with maturity, and naturally leverages modern AI tools to improve productivity and decision-making.

You’ll have significant ownership, autonomy, and impact on how the company grows.

What you’ll do:

• Build company-wide HR programs, processes, and frameworks from the ground up
• Support core HR cycles, including performance reviews, compensation reviews, engagement surveys, and calibration processes
• Design and lead learning experiences, workshops, and development initiatives across the company

jobs.title: HR Business Partner
jobs.description:
Job Description:

This is the HR seat at the table for our Norwegian business. You’ll be the person leaders call when they need a thinking partner — the one who coaches, challenges, and helps them turn ambition into action. That might mean helping a manager think through a difficult people decision, or getting hands-on with a sensitive case when needed. Either way, you take clear ownership of the local people agenda from start to finish.

You’ll work shoulder-to-shoulder with our HR expert network across the Nordics and globally — drawing on their depth, but bringing the local fluency that keeps things grounded in Norwegian reality. Strategy and operations both land on your desk, and you’re equally at home with both.

What You’ll Actually Do

• Be the trusted partner to leaders Coach managers through the full employee lifecycle — onboarding, follow-ups, performance conversations, sickness absence, conflict, and the harder employee relations cases. You bring calm judgment and a clear point of view, even when the conversation is uncomfortable.
• Translate business strategy into people plans Take what the business is trying to achieve and turn it into HR activity that actually moves the needle. No HR-for-HR’s-sake.
• Own the annual people cycle Goal-setting, development reviews, performance management, talent and succession, salary and bonus rounds, engagement surveys — you run the rhythm and make sure the follow-up is meaningful, not performative.
• Keep us compliant — and a good place to work You’re our expert on the Norwegian Working Environment Act and HSE (HMS). You’ll make sure our Working Environment Committee (AMU) and verneombud structure work as intended, prepare HR content for AMU meetings, and lead on HSE reporting.
• Lead on labor law and ER cases Confident, pragmatic advice on Norwegian labor law. Steady hands on the cases that matter.
• Turn data into decisions Sickness absence, turnover, engagement, compliance, risk — you read the signals, spot the patterns, and bring leaders insights they can act on.
• Guide leaders through change Reorganizations, role clarifications, evolving ways of working — you help leaders navigate it with care and clarity.
• Bring local execution to global initiatives You implement group-wide HR processes locally in a way that fits Norway — not by bending Norway to fit the process.
• Champion a diverse, engaged, high-performing team Partner with business leaders to build the kind of workforce we’re proud of.

Experience

What you bring

• 5–7+ years as an HR Business Partner, HR Manager, or similar — ideally inside a global matrix or group structure
• Solid grounding in Norwegian labor law and HSE (HMS)
• Track record in organizations going through change, with highly skilled people

Education

• Higher education in HR, organization, law, economics, or equivalent. A relevant master’s is a plus.

Language

• Fluent written and spoken Norwegian and English

Capability

• Strong leadership presence and solid project management chops

Who You Are

You’re proactive — you’d rather move things forward than wait for the perfect moment. You own your deliverables and get them done, pragmatically. You’re confident enough in HR to challenge leaders respectfully, and self-aware enough to know when to listen. You read cultural cues well and bridge differing views without flattening them. You build trust quickly and keep it. You see HR through a commercial lens, balance analysis with action, and bring high personal integrity to everything. And you’re genuinely good to work with — the kind of teammate people are glad to have on the project.

About Dentsu And Dentsu Norway

Dentsu is a global partner for growth and transformation for the world’s leading businesses. Founded in Tokyo in 1901, the company today operates in around 120 countries. Through integrated services across Media, CXM, and Creative, dentsu creates holistic solutions that drive growth, innovation, and sustainable development.

Dentsu Norwa

jobs.title: People Infrastructure Lead (Systems, Data & Compensation)
jobs.description:
Description

Upwind is a next-generation Cloud Security Platform that leverages runtime context to identify and prioritize critical risks, providing precise insights and efficient cloud security management. Unlike traditional tools, Upwind uses runtime data proactively for risk prioritization and posture insights, ensuring teams focus on what truly matters. With industry-leading efficiency and eBPF-powered sensors, Upwind delivers comprehensive capabilities — including agentless cloud posture discovery, real-time threat protection, and integrated API security. We're in a period of significant growth. There's an enormous amount to build, improve, and shape - and every hire changes the trajectory of the company.

What This Role Is

Think of this as the platform engineering role for our People function. Just like a platform team builds the systems that let engineers ship fast - you'll build the operational layer that lets the entire company run fast.

Real-time data. Automated workflows. Compensation logic that actually scales. No legacy systems to untangle, no inherited processes to maintain. Full ownership over how People infrastructure gets designed, built, and operated at Upwind.

This isn't traditional People Ops. It's the technical backbone behind it.

What You'll Build

• Own the People infrastructure end-to-end - HiBob and the integrated ecosystem around it.
• Engineer frictionless, automated lifecycle workflows across the entire employee journey - from offer to offboarding.
• Build the compensation infrastructure from the ground up: leveling, salary bands, benchmarking, and the logic that ties them together.
• Turn organizational data into a real-time, high-fidelity source of truth that leaders actually trust.
• Deploy AI and automation to eliminate manual work — not assist it.
• Give leadership the visibility and operational agility to make fast, confident decisions at any scale.

These are the core domains. What you build within them and how - is largely up to you.

You'll thrive here if

• You've built People systems from scratch - not maintained someone else's.
• You think in systems and data, not tickets and tasks.
• You're technically comfortable - you can turn a People challenge into an automated workflow without waiting for IT.
• Compensation logic excites you, not intimidates you.
• You've worked in a high-growth environment and know exactly what breaks at scale.
• You're excited by using AI to replace manual work - not just dress it up.
• You move decisions forward instead of getting stuck in discussions.

Requirements

• Experience building or operating scalable People systems in high-growth tech environments.
• Background in People Operations / HRIS / Compensation - or BizOps / Operations with strong systems ownership.
• Hands-on with HiBob (or equivalent HRIS) and the automation layer around it (n8n, Zapier, LLMs, or similar).
• Strong grasp of organizational structure, compensation frameworks, and what it takes to scale them.
• Fluent in English - this is a global, cross-functional role.

jobs.title: Director of People
jobs.description:

Today, more people than ever are speaking publicly about their mental health. Whether it's ourselves, our friends and family or even public figures, taking care of your behavioral health is no longer a taboo, it's vital, and it's only human.

Eleos is on a mission to help deliver the world's most effective behavioral care through data, measurement, and personalization. Or simply put, we want to give clinicians the support they need to do the important work only they can do.

What is this opportunity?

We have a unique culture that places a high emphasis on talent and people. Our focus on our people has helped us build a team we could not be more proud of, and we are now growing while continuing to strengthen and improve our people’s experience.

You bring strong expertise in change management at growing companies, and your superpower is preparing organizations and leaders to successfully navigate growth and transformation. You know how to build strong cultures, elevate leadership capability, and translate business needs into practical people strategies.

You radically own what is on your plate and actively look for ways to build growth engines that increase your impact. You are known for strong project management skills, creativity, judgment, and a hands-on approach. You are equally comfortable shaping strategy and rolling up your sleeves to get things done.

How will you contribute?

• 负责高管激励制度合规风控、流程梳理、宣贯沟通与政策解读，联动财务、法务等部门，保障激励方案合规高效落地，解决执行过程中的各类问题。
• 定期复盘高管激励方案执行效果，结合行业趋势与公司发展阶段，迭代优化方案，提升激励效能与高管体验，形成可复制的最佳实践。

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner
jobs.description:
At Qodo, we’re building an AI Code Review platform that helps developers move fast, ship with confidence, and elevate code quality across the SDLC through deep, scalable codebase understanding.

We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Partner to join our People team. Someone experienced enough to lead hiring processes end-to-end - but still hungry to grow, constantly improve, and help shape what recruiting looks like in an AI-first company.

If you're looking to do more than recruitment- this is an opportunity to influence how we hire, who we hire, and how we scale.

This is about building teams, influencing decisions, and making Qodo win.

Our Team’s Values And How We Work

• One team. Clear ownership, zero silos
• High standards. We care about quality and speed
• No ego. We challenge each other to get better
• Mission-driven. We do what it takes to make Qodo win

What You’ll Do

• Own full-cycle recruiting across Engineering, Product, and GTM roles - from building pipelines across channels, through interviews, to closing
• Partner closely with hiring managers to deeply understand needs (technical + cultural), shape roles, and guide hiring decisions
• Work hand-in-hand with the Talent Acquisition Coordinator to run efficient, high-quality processes
• Create exceptional candidate experiences - fast, sharp, human
• Track and analyze pipeline data to continuously improve how we hire
• Contribute beyond recruiting: employer branding, People initiatives, and anything else that moves the needle

Requirements:

Who You Are

• 5+ years of technical recruiting experience (startup / high-growth environment preferred), with a strong understanding of recruitment best practices and current trends
• A team player with excellent interpersonal and communication skills, who shows up for others while holding a high bar
• You take ownership end-to-end, bring a marathon mindset (not literally, we’re not runners either), and know how to push things forward and get things done
• You’re comfortable working with different tools and leveraging AI (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) to build smarter, more efficient processes
• Fluent in English, with the ability to conduct interviews in English
• Hands-on experience with Spark Hire and HiBob

jobs.title: Total Rewards Analyst
jobs.description:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

Role Summary

The Total Rewards Analyst supports the development, analysis, and administration of Payoneer’s global compensation and benefits programs. The role is heavily focused on global compensation benchmarking, salary range management, annual cycles, and support for global wellbeing and benefits programs. This position works across regions and partners closely with TR region partners, HRBPs, and People Services to ensure accurate data, strong governance, and a consistent employee experience in line with Payoneer’s Total Rewards philosophy.

What You’ll Do

• Compensation & Benchmarking
• Support global market data collection and job matching; analyze survey results to produce insights and recommendations.
• Assist in building and maintaining global salary ranges and supporting tools.
• Contribute to the annual compensation cycle, including data validation, planning templates, quality checks, and reporting.
• Benefits & Wellbeing Programs
• Support global and local benefits administration, including renewals, vendor coordination, and employee inquiries.
• Contribute to global wellbeing programs and initiatives (e.g., wellness, EAP, regional benefits updates).
• Programs, Policy & Governance
• Maintain job data accuracy across systems by supporting JD repository updates and assisting with job architecture alignment.
• Assist in compliance-related tasks such as audit requests, eligibility checks, and documentation.
• Analytics, Reporting & Tools
• Conduct advanced analysis in Excel or Google Sheets; develop dashboards where helpful.
• Support data preparation for TR leadership and cross-functional partners.
• Cross-Functional Partnership
• Collaborate with HRBPs, Talent Acquisition, Finance, and People Services on TR-related processes, data needs, and employee questions.
• Respond to employee and manager inquiries with clarity and professionalism.

What We’re Looking For

• Experience & Skills
• 2–4+ years of experience in Compensation, Benefits, or broader Total Rewards; global company experience preferred.
• Strong analytical skills with advanced Excel or Google Sheets capabilities; experience with PowerBI, Python, or similar tools is a plus (not required).
• Foundational understanding of compensation fundamentals (e.g., benchmarking, job matching, salary structures, annual cycles).
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple deliverables simultaneously.
• Clear and concise communication skills; ability to explain TR concepts to non-experts.
• Comfort working autonomously in a fast-moving, high-ambiguity environment with opportunities to build new processes and frameworks.
• Mindset & Behaviors
• Curiosity and willingness to experiment, learn new tools, and improve existing processes.
• High accuracy and attention to detail.
• Team-oriented, highly collaborative, and comfortable working across time zones.

The Payoneer Ways of Working

Act as our customer’s partner on the inside

Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.

Do it. Own it.

Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.

Continuously improve

Always striving for a higher standard than our last.

Build Each Other Up

Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.

If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be

jobs.title: Technical Recruiter
jobs.description:
Gini Apps is looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Technical Recruiter to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will play a critical role in identifying, attracting and recruiting top technical talent to help us achieve our ambitious goals. You will work closely with hiring managers and clients to understand their needs and deliver exceptional candidates who align with the company’s culture and values. Your expertise in the technology landscape will be critical in identifying and connecting with potential candidates, ensuring an efficient and effective recruitment process.

Responsibilities:

• Sourcing and identifying potential candidates through various channels, including job boards, social media and networking events.
• Conducting detailed interviews to assess candidates’ technical skills, experience and cultural fit with the company’s clients.
• Managing the full recruitment lifecycle, from job posting, interviews to job offer negotiation and onboarding.
• Collaborate with hiring managers to understand their workforce needs and develop effective recruiting strategies.
• Maintain a strong pipeline of qualified candidates for current and future recruiting needs.
• Utilize recruiting metrics to analyze and improve the recruiting process.

Requirements:

• Minimum 1 year of experience in technical recruiting.
• In-depth understanding of various technical roles and the software development lifecycle.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to build relationships with candidates and hiring managers.
• Experience working with customers.
• Experience working with social networks, especially LinkedIn.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.
• Proven ability to work independently and as part of a team.

jobs.title: (Senior) HR Business Partner (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Ihr neuer Arbeitsplatz in Magdeburg – Technik, die bewegt

An unserem Standort in Magdeburg sorgen über 250 engagierte Mitarbeitende dafür, dass Gas- und Dieselmotoren sowie elektrifizierte Hybridsysteme zuverlässig instand gesetzt und gewartet werden.

Unsere besondere Stärke liegt in der industriellen Wiederaufbereitung kompletter Motoren, Systeme und PowerPacks. Diese werden bei uns grundlegend überholt und für ein zweites oder sogar drittes Leben fit gemacht. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und bringen Sie Ihr Know-how in die nachhaltige Aufbereitung von Motoren und Baugruppen ein.

Aufgaben - Das Erwartet Sie Bei Uns

• Strategische Beratung und enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Führungskräften am Standort Magdeburg und Berlin in allen personalrelevanten Fragestellungen sowie Sparringspartner in den Bereichen Führung, Konfliktmanagement und Teamentwicklung
• Vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit mit dem Betriebsrat in allen mitbestimmungspflichtigen Angelegenheiten
• Entwicklung, Umsetzung und Begleitung von HR-Strategien und -Projekten (z. B. Ta-lentmanagement, Nachfolgeplanung, Organisationsentwicklung)
• Unterstützung bei Veränderungsprozessen und Transformationsprojekten, inkl. Change-Management
• Analyse und Optimierung von HR-Prozessen und Kennzahlen
• Sicherstellung der Einhaltung arbeitsrechtlicher Vorgaben sowie Beratung zu relevanten rechtlichen Themen
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Rolls-Royce Konzernmutter in UK, HR CoC (Center of Competence), HR Operations und externen Dienstleistern
• Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Dienstreisen an den Rolls-Royce Solutions Standort in Berlin

Qualifikationen - Was Wir Uns Wünschen

• Abgeschlossenes Studium in Wirtschaftspsychologie, Betriebswirtschaft, Personalmanagement oder Rechtswissenschaften mit Schwerpunkt Arbeitsrecht – alternativ eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als HR Business Partner oder in einer vergleichbaren HR-Funktion
• Fundierte Kenntnisse im Arbeitsrecht und in modernen HR-Instrumenten
• Erfahrung im Change Management, in Transformationsprojekten und Organisationsentwicklung
• Starke Beratungskompetenz, kommunikatives Geschick und souveränes Auftreten
• Analytische Fähigkeiten sowie ein strategisches und lösungsorientiertes Mindset
• Hohe Eigeninitiative, Teamfähigkeit und Verhandlungssicherheit
• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Warum Rolls-Royce Power Systems – Das Bieten Wir Ihnen

• Gesunde und faire Arbeitsbedingungen durch Tarifbindung (Metall- und Elektroindustrie)
• Betriebseigene Krankenkasse BKK MTU für unsere Mitarbeitenden und Familienangehörigen
• Umfangreiches betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement inklusive Firmenfitnessprogramm (EGYM Wellpass)
• Attraktive betriebliche Altersvorsorge – Mit uns für das Alter sparen!
• Berufsunfähigkeitsversicherung – Absicherung für alle Fälle!
• Mobilitätsunterstützung im Alltag – Jobrad

Wir sind ein Arbeitgeber, der sich für Chancengleichheit einsetzt. Wir setzen uns für die Entwicklung einer vielfältigen Belegschaft und eines integrativen Arbeitsumfelds ein. Wir glauben, dass Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen und Kulturen uns unterschiedliche Perspektiven geben. Und je mehr Perspektiven wir haben, desto erfolgreicher werden wir sein. Durch den Aufbau einer Kultur des Respekts und der Wertschätzung geben wir jedem, der hier arbeitet, die Möglichkeit, sein volles Potenzial auszuschöpfen.

Type of Contract

Permanent

jobs.title: R&D Recruiter
jobs.description:
ScaleOps, the leader in real-time automated cloud resource management, is revolutionizing how DevOps teams manage their cloud-native application infrastructures. Backed by venture capital and software industry titans, ScaleOps’ platform removes the organizational friction between application owners and DevOps teams by fully automating the resource management process to meet real-time demand.

The ScaleOps platform dynamically manages the application’s resource allocation, eliminating the need for manual intervention. The result is improved application performance, 60%- 80% cloud cost savings, and a fully automated allocation process.

With well over $80 million in backing, ScaleOps has seen tremendous business growth, attracting global industry leaders to its customer base. ScaleOps automatically manages the production environments of over 50 enterprises, including Wiz, CATO Networks, Outreach, SentinelOne, Maxar, Playtika, Orca Security, EQ Bank, Outbrain, PayU, and Noname.

We are seeking an experienced R&D Recruiter preferably with a background in startups company. The Talent Acquisition Partner will be responsible for managing the hiring process, from sourcing candidates to managing the interview process, with a strong focus on creating an exceptional candidate experience.

What You Will Be Doing:

• Manage the full recruitment life cycle, including planning and executing creative and targeted recruitment strategies.
• Source candidates through social media, job boards, and internal databases.
• Conduct interviews and managing the interview process from start to finish.
• Work closely with department heads to understand role requirements and support hiring decisions.
• Build relationships with candidates and maintain regular follow-up throughout the hiring process.
• Utilize and maintain up-to-date candidate data in Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS).

Requirements:

What You Bring Along:

• Min 3 years of experience in recruitment, preferably in a startup environment.
• Familiarity with fast-paced hiring processes and the ability to thrive in a dynamic environment.
• Strong multitasking skills and attention to detail.
• Excellent communication skills in both English and Hebrew, both written and verbal.
• Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively, with a proactive and initiative-driven approach.
• Experience with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) is a plus.
